panels.title: Total Pipelines

panels.title: Total Consumer Lag

panels.description: Number of pipeline workers currently owned by this coordinator instance.
panels.title: Owned pipelines

panels.title: Pipeline errors / sec by class

panels.title: Pool Acquire Duration P95

panels.title: Healthy Pipelines by Tenant
Fan-In Source Lag
panels.description: Per-source consumer lag for all fan-in pipelines.

panels.title: Fan-In Messages Merged / sec
panels.description: Rate of messages merged per source outbox in fan-in pipelines.

panels.title: Backfill Jobs
panels.description: Active backfill jobs with source outbox, rows processed, percent complete, and estimated completion.

targets.rawSql: SELECT job_name, outbox_name, status, rows_processed, rows_total, CASE WHEN rows_total > 0 THEN ROUND(rows_processed::numeric/rows_total*100,1) ELSE 0 END AS pct_complete, created_at FROM tide.backfill_jobs WHERE status IN ('pending','running','paused') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

title: pg-tide Relay Health
